newsitem.title: USA: FTA awards $3.7 mln in transit funds to Ill. DOT.
newsitem.headline: FTA awards $3.7 mln in transit funds to Ill. DOT.

text.p: Federal Transit Administrator (FTA) Gordon J. Linton Friday announced the award of $3.7 million in FTA funding to the Illinois Department of Transportation for the purchase of 17 replacement buses for four urbanized areas in Illinois.

"President Clinton is committed to investing in transportation to upgrade vehicles to make transit systems safer, more efficient and accessible to all," Linton said in a statement. "These improvements also will increase service reliability and reduce maintenance costs."
